newsitem.title: JAPAN: Itochu to step up gasoline sales under own name.
newsitem.headline: Itochu to step up gasoline sales under own name.

text.p: Itochu Corp said on Monday it plans to step up gasoline sales under its own brand name, rather than the names of refiners.

Itochu, which opened the first petrol station under its own name in February, plans to set up about 10 similar service stations in the 1997 financial year, which begins on Tuesday, a company spokesman said.
Refiner Taiyo Oil Co Ltd, with a crude processing capacity of 89,000 barrel-per-day, will supply oil products to those stations.
Gasoline stations in Japan have traditionally had an exclusive tie with one specific refiner, and sold oil products under the refiner's name.

Following a market deregulation last April, however, supermarket operators Daiei Inc and Jusco Co Ltd broke into the gasoline retail business, and started selling oil products under original brand names.

Itochu has no intention of importing gasoline for the new stations, at least for the time being, as imported cargoes are not economically competitive in the domestic market due to the weaker yen, he added.
